summary_1line: Bhishma recounts a worm’s rise to Brahmanhood through righteousness and introduces a debate where Vyasa praises charitable giving above other virtues.

image_candidates.scene_text: A humble worm transforms into a radiant Brahmana while the sage Vyasa stands before him in a forest hermitage.
Maitreya welcomes the disguised Vyasa in his hermitage at Baranasi, offering him a seat and food as the sage suddenly laughs with delight.
An ascetic Brahmana performs great sacrifices, the earth around him marked with a thousand sacrificial stakes.
